about: The speech models of the target language (T04, research G6). The ASR and TTS ids are ids of models/manifest.json; the guide's voice is the speaker of the TTS model the scripted --speak lines use (Kokoro 28, ef_dora); the NPCs' voices are in game/npcs/<id>.json. The threshold is the mean per-word confidence under which a recognition is uncertain (D-game-9), measured with Kokoro speech through Vosk small Spanish: correct phrases give 0.77 to 1.00 (the lowest word, 'si', 0.50), a mis-heard 'hola' 0.36; the one number to tune in the playtest. Thresholds are keyed by ASR model, so another recognizer brings its own.
